title: 报表面板其余说明文字：ja-JP、es-ES、zh-CN 仍是 #36447 改写前的开发者用语（接 #36836）
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Filing gate: ① a shipped-text defect (release-text exception), out of #36836 (os-dev report on #36836, PR #37377), filed by the owning zone under the parent, per the maintainer's standing permission for areas to file their own follow-up cards. Source: fleet.
Grading: area:ux · Bug · p2 · reach: exception: release-text (shipped translated strings, read by every Studio builder in ja-JP, es-ES or zh-CN) · evidence: read by the dev on `origin/main` `98bda0ac`.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：报表设计面板里还有一批说明文字，英文已在 #36447 改成业务说法，日文、西班牙文（部分中文）还是旧的开发者说法。#36836 只修了点名的六行和四个标签，这张卡收尾其余的。
- 谁受益：用日文、西班牙文、中文搭报表的人，读到的说明和英文一致。
- 不做会怎样：同一个面板一半新说法、一半旧说法。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

On the Studio report panel, these ja-JP / es-ES leaves (zh-CN shares several) still translate the wording from before #36447; each should follow the current English:
- `columns.helpText` (横方向のディメンション名…), `order.helpText` (ソートキー… rows/columns), `blocks.helpText` (データセットにバインドされた…), `chart.helpText` (チャート設定（type, legend, colors）), `dateRange.helpText` (…データセットの日付ディメンション…), `exportOptions.helpText` (…データセットのオブジェクト…)
- the `joined_blocks` and `filter_and_chart` section descriptions.

Files: `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/{ja-JP,es-ES,zh-CN}.metadata-forms.generated.ts` (translated values are authored in place there; `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` keeps them) and the report ledgers that pin these leaves. Vocabulary: follow the words PR #37377 settled (数据来源 / 指标 / 分组 / 列分组 · データソース / 指標 / グループ化 / 列のグループ化 · Fuente de datos / Métricas / Agrupar por / Agrupar columnas por).

## Acceptance

- Each leaf listed above, in ja-JP, es-ES and (where it is stale) zh-CN, follows the current English; the PR names every leaf it re-translated.
- `check:i18n` and the translation tests stay green.

## Order

After PR #37377 merges (same bundles).

Blocked-by: #37377

Reader: zone o5-U (seat repo:objectstack#5) claims it after #37377 lands.
Dedupe: open issues for "report panel translation helpText" return 2 (#36836, the parent; the triage seat post); none covers these leaves.
